material_decisions.answer: `--overdue` is a boolean flag that takes no value.
material_decisions.why_material: This determines the public CLI syntax and argument-error behavior.

material_decisions.answer: A task is overdue only when it has a due date strictly earlier than the current date; a task due today is not overdue.
material_decisions.why_material: The boundary condition directly determines which tasks the filter returns.

material_decisions.answer: Completed tasks are excluded from `--overdue`, even when their due date is in the past.
material_decisions.why_material: Completion-state treatment changes externally visible filter membership.

material_decisions.answer: Determine the current date in UTC, and structure the overdue calculation so tests can supply a fixed current date without changing the CLI.
material_decisions.why_material: A specified date boundary and controllable clock prevent host-time-zone and midnight-dependent results.

material_decisions.answer: Allow `--overdue` to be combined with `--priority` and `--due`; all supplied filters are intersected. Therefore, `--due DATE --overdue` returns matches only when DATE is strictly before the current UTC date and the task is incomplete.
material_decisions.why_material: This defines accepted option combinations and removes ambiguity about their membership semantics.

owner_rules: Overdue is a derived listing condition, not persisted task state.
Apply overdue filtering without changing row formatting or the established post-filter sorting behavior.
An empty overdue result is a successful empty listing.
Test the overdue boundary with incomplete past-due, due-today, future-due, undated, and completed past-due tasks using a fixed current date.
Overdue is a derived listing condition, not persisted task state.
Apply overdue filtering without changing row formatting or the established post-filter sorting behavior.
An empty overdue result is a successful empty listing.
Test the overdue boundary with incomplete past-due, due-today, future-due, undated, and completed past-due tasks using a fixed current date.

open_material_decisions: CLI shape: whether --overdue is a boolean flag or accepts a value.
Filter composition: whether --overdue combines conjunctively with --priority and --due, especially the meaning of --overdue plus an exact --due date.
Overdue eligibility: whether due today qualifies and whether completed past-due tasks qualify.
Reference date: which clock/timezone determines today and how tests inject or control it.

question.prompt: Which tasks should `todo list --overdue` include? This determines the filter’s core observable behavior.

options.label: Incomplete, before today
options.description: Include only unfinished tasks whose due date is strictly earlier than today; due-today, completed, and undated tasks are excluded.

options.label: All before today
options.description: Include completed and unfinished tasks whose due date is strictly earlier than today; due-today and undated tasks are excluded.

options.label: Incomplete, due by today
options.description: Include only unfinished tasks whose due date is today or earlier; completed and undated tasks are excluded.

open_material_decisions: CLI shape: whether --overdue is a boolean flag or accepts a value.
Filter composition: whether --overdue combines conjunctively with --priority and --due, especially the meaning of --overdue plus an exact --due date.
Reference date: which clock/timezone determines today and how tests inject or control it.

question.prompt: How should `--overdue` interact with the existing `--priority` and `--due` filters?

options.label: Combine with both
options.description: Apply all supplied filters conjunctively; `--due DATE --overdue` matches only when that exact date is before today and the task is incomplete.

options.label: Priority only
options.description: Allow `--overdue` with `--priority`, but reject its use with `--due` as a usage error.

options.label: Use alone
options.description: Reject `--overdue` whenever either existing filter is also supplied.

open_material_decisions: CLI shape: whether `--overdue` is a value-free boolean flag or accepts a value.
Reference date: whether “today” is the machine-local calendar date or UTC, and how tests control it deterministically.

question.prompt: Which calendar date should define “before today” for `--overdue`? This changes results around timezone boundaries and determines the test seam.

options.label: Local date + seam
options.description: Use the machine-local calendar date in production and an internal injectable/patchable date provider for deterministic tests.

options.label: UTC date + seam
options.description: Use the UTC calendar date in production and an internal injectable/patchable date provider for deterministic tests.

options.label: Local date direct
options.description: Call the machine-local date directly and rely on process-level clock control or patching the imported date in tests.

question.prompt: How should users activate the overdue filter? This determines parsing, help text, and invalid-input behavior.

options.label: Boolean flag
options.description: Use `todo list --overdue` as a value-free `store_true` flag; this matches the request’s wording and conventional filter syntax.

options.label: Boolean value
options.description: Require a value such as `--overdue true`, adding parsing and validation behavior without enabling another requested use case.

options.label: Optional value
options.description: Accept both `--overdue` and forms such as `--overdue true|false`, offering flexibility at the cost of a more complex public interface.
